summary.one_liner: Nagios Core 4.x is a C-based host, service, and network monitoring program with an optional CGI web interface, released under the GPL v2.
summary.what_it_does: Nagios Core monitors network services (SMTP, POP3, HTTP, PING, and similar) and host resources such as processor load and disk usage. It supports user-developed plugins for custom checks. Hosts can be arranged in a parent hierarchy so that down hosts can be told apart from unreachable ones. It sends notifications when problems occur and when they are resolved, by email, pager, or a user-defined method. It can run event handlers for proactive problem resolution and rotates and archives its log files automatically. An optional web interface shows current status, notification and problem history, and the log file.
use_cases: monitor network services like HTTP and SMTP
track host CPU load and disk usage
get alerts by email or pager when servers fail
distinguish down hosts from unreachable hosts
view monitoring status through a web dashboard
run automatic recovery scripts via event handlers
how_to_run: Quickstart installation guides are linked from the README (external; no commands given in the README).
notable: Plugin interface for user-written service checks
Parent host hierarchy distinguishes down from unreachable hosts
Optional CGI web interface for status and history
Event handlers for automated problem response
caveats: README gives no build or install commands; it points to external quickstart guides
Web interface is optional and provided through CGI programs
